changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Update the yearly finance summary template to runtime-queryable MySQL finance source tables.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE copilot_ai.nl2sql_query_template SET domain = 'finance', role_hint = NULL, intent_patterns = '[".*(20\\d{2}|\\d{4}年|今年|去年).*(财务|收款|回款|应收|实收).*(数据|情况|统计|汇总|总览).*",".*(财务|收款|回款|应收|实收).*(20\\d{2}|\\d{4}年|今年|去年).*(数据|情况|统计|汇总|总览).*"]', question_samples = '["2026年财务数据统计下","看下2026年财务数据统计","今年财务数据汇总"]', sql_template = $tpl$ WITH settlement AS ( SELECT CONCAT(CAST(m.settlement_year AS VARCHAR), '-', LPAD(CAST(m.settlement_month AS VARCHAR), 2, '0')) AS month_key, COUNT(DISTINCT m.project_id) AS settlement_project_count, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(m.receivable_total_amount, DECIMAL '0.00')), 2) AS receivable_before_discount, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(m.folding_after_total_amount, DECIMAL '0.00')), 2) AS discounted_receivable, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(m.total_amount, DECIMAL '0.00')), 2) AS paid_amount, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(m.folding_after_total_amount, DECIMAL '0.00') - COALESCE(m.total_amount, DECIMAL '0.00')), 2) AS unpaid_amount, ROUND( CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(m.folding_after_total_amount, DECIMAL '0.00')) = DECIMAL '0.00' THEN DECIMAL '0.0000' ELSE SUM(COALESCE(m.total_amount, DECIMAL '0.00')) / SUM(COALESCE(m.folding_after_total_amount, DECIMAL '0.00')) END, 4 ) AS payment_progress FROM mysql.rs_cloud_flower.a_month_accounting m WHERE m.settlement_year = :year GROUP BY m.settlement_year, m.settlement_month ), collection AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.pay_time, '%Y-%m') AS month_key, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(c.pay_amoney, DECIMAL '0.00')), 2) AS collection_amount, COUNT(*) AS collection_record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.project_id) AS collection_project_count FROM mysql.rs_cloud_flower.a_collection_record c WHERE c.pay_time >= TIMESTAMP ':year-01-01 00:00:00' AND c.pay_time < TIMESTAMP ':year-01-01 00:00:00' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.pay_time, '%Y-%m') ) SELECT COALESCE(s.month_key, c.month_key) AS "财务月份", COALESCE(s.settlement_project_count, 0) AS "结算项目数", COALESCE(s.receivable_before_discount, DECIMAL '0.00') AS "应收折前", COALESCE(s.discounted_receivable, DECIMAL '0.00') AS "折后实收", COALESCE(s.paid_amount, DECIMAL '0.00') AS "已回款", COALESCE(s.unpaid_amount, DECIMAL '0.00') AS "未回款", COALESCE(s.payment_progress, DECIMAL '0.0000') AS "回款进度", COALESCE(c.collection_amount, DECIMAL '0.00') AS "收款金额", COALESCE(c.collection_record_count, 0) AS "收款单数", COALESCE(c.collection_project_count, 0) AS "收款项目数" FROM settlement s FULL OUTER JOIN collection c ON s.month_key = c.month_key ORDER BY COALESCE(s.month_key, c.month_key) $tpl$, parameters = '{"year":{"type":"integer","required":true}}', target_view = 'mysql.rs_cloud_flower.a_month_accounting', description = '年度财务数据统计', priority = 40, is_active = true, updated_at = now() WHERE template_code = 'TPL-56';
